task_title: Find the token-accounting bug in the scorecard SQL
output: (1) Bug: avg_tokens only sums `inputTokens` + `outputTokens` and drops `cacheReadInputTokens` / `cacheCreationInputTokens`, so cached-prompt usage never enters the average. (2) Under subscription billing `cost_cents` is always 0, so tokens are the only cost signal—omitting cache tokens undercounts real usage and skews cost and quality-per-token comparisons (cache-heavy runs look cheaper/better than they are). (3) Corrected numerator: `coalesce((hr.usage_json->>'inputTokens')::numeric,0) + coalesce((hr.usage_json->>'outputTokens')::numeric,0) + coalesce((hr.usage_json->>'cacheReadInputTokens')::numeric,0) + coalesce((hr.usage_json->>'cacheCreationInputTokens')::numeric,0)`.

judgeDetail.rationale: Correctly diagnoses the cache-token exclusion and gives a COALESCE-wrapped null-safe numerator summing all four fields without double-counting, in a tight three-point answer.
